title: The Rule and Exercises of Holy Dying
author: Jeremy Taylor
tradition_notes: Jeremy Taylor's Holy Dying (1651) is the companion to Holy Living. Written during the grief of Taylor's patron's wife, it is the definitive Anglican treatment of Christian preparation for death. Widely regarded as one of the finest works of 17th-century English prose.
source_edition: The Rule and Exercises of Holy Dying. CCEL edition.
